item.title: Florida leaders push back against federal offshore drilling proposal
item.description: Florida leaders will gather at Pier 60 Park on Friday in opposition to a federal proposal to expand offshore drilling off Florida's Gulf Coast.

item.title: Universal employee attacked by family of 4 in parking dispute: affidavit
item.description: A Universal employee was attacked by four guests on Monday after she refused to validate their parking tickets, the Orange County Sheriff's Office said.
